name: Nordrest Holding AB (publ)
summary: Nordrest Holding AB (publ) is an international foodservice enterprise active in Sweden and globally. Its operations primarily encompass the management of restaurants and cafes, where a focus on guest experience and efficient flow is paramount, alongside offering tailor-made, contract-based dining solutions. The company further extends its services to include catering. Serving a wide array of clients, Nordrest supports the defense, corporate, education, healthcare, elderly care, and travel industries. It manages a diverse portfolio of brands such as Taste by Nordrest, Togo by Nordrest, Pocket by Nordrest, La Girafe, Dinners, and Way Cup. Founded in 2013, Nordrest is headquartered in Solna, Sweden.
